channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Gilbert Arenas | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Gilbert Arenas from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Glen Davis on Corey Maggette, Gilbert Arenas, Matt Barnes, Tony Allen
item.description:
“Matt Barnes, Stephen Jack; all those people were investigated. Gilbert Arenas, Corey Maggette, Cutino Mobley; thousands of NBA players were investigated. They just let some of them go to jail. Some of them, the fed got, like, Tony Allen. He didn't go to jail. Whatever he did to get free.”

Glen Davis on Corey Maggette, Gilbert Arenas, Matt Barnes, Tony Allen, Sep 5, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Nick Young on Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
Nick Young:

“Gil had played [Gilbert Arenas]. So he came and got me. Once he started doing the whole podcast stuff, he didn’t have time to be the coach. So I took over as the coach. We ended up winning the championship.”

Nick Young on Gilbert Arenas, Jul 15, 2026. Source: R.Org Sports.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Anthony Edwards:

“I receive a lot of negative criticism because I never go for the tie. I heard Gilbert Arenas not to long ago say I'm trying to go home. I'm going for the game every time”

Anthony Edwards on Gilbert Arenas, Dec 20, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kwame Brown on Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
Kwame Brown on Gilbert Arenas:

“Why the [ __ ] would he do that with all that money he making? That was the only reason why I popped up on here, man. I had to ask you that one, dog.”

Kwame Brown on Gilbert Arenas, Jul 31, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Nick Young on Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
Nick Young:

“But don't worry. Don't worry about the show or nothing, Gil. I got that now. We might as well just change the show to Swaggy’s Arena. In conjunction with Gilbert, we gonna put a little Gilbert sign on the side. It’s still Swaggy’s Arena until you come back home. And once you get out, it's back to you. But for now—I got it.”

Nick Young on Gilbert Arenas, Jul 31, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jason Richardson on Gilbert Arenas, George McCloud, Danny Fortson
item.description:
Jason Richardson:

“We were playing the Nuggets—it’s like two or three minutes into the game. Danny (Fortson) and George McCloud get into it. Boom. Me and Gilbert looking at each other like, 'Yo, what’s going on? This is two minutes into the game. How they already ready to fight?' Techs and everything.”

Jason Richardson on Gilbert Arenas, George McCloud, Danny Fortson, Jun 5, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: CJ McCollum on Allen Iverson, Steve Nash, Gilbert Arenas, Richard Hamilton
item.description:
When asked about the players who influenced his style, CJ McCollum rattled off a list of all-time greats.

“Besides my brother? I watched a lot of Allen Iverson. I watched a lot of Steve Nash. I watched a lot of Rip Hamilton. I watched young Gilbert [Arenas] and obviously Kobe and Mike,”

CJ McCollum on Allen Iverson, Steve Nash, Gilbert Arenas, Richard Hamilton, Mar 23, 2025. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
Anthony Edwards:

“Like Gilbert Arenas said, I don't do overtime, so f*ck it”

Anthony Edwards on Gilbert Arenas, Dec 28, 2024. Source: reddit.

item.title: Payton Pritchard on Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
“Well, first of all, I really liked Gilbert as a player and I respected his game. I was a fan growing up. So when you see somebody that you’re a fan of growing up and then they make comments like that. It’s definitely disappointing talking about something people can’t change, the color of their skin. So the work that Drew puts in, that I put in, I don’t know, you just don’t want to see that,”

Payton Pritchard on Gilbert Arenas, Dec 6, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Paul George on Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
Engaging in discourse with his former teammate Paul George, the point guard was asked by George if he considers himself the greatest Washington player of all time.

“I know we had Gil (Gilbert Arenas) here earlier in the season and he mentioned that he would give the nod to you as being the greatest Wizard of all time,”

Paul George on Gilbert Arenas, Jun 26, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Kelvin Sampson on Gilbert Arenas, Hakeem Olajuwon
item.description:
“Gilbert, I respect his game to whatever degree, but when you try to compare that to ‘The Dream,' Hakeem Olajuwon, big man back in the day, the skill-set and the footwork that Hakeem had, [Arenas] needs to go back and look at some more film because I don't think he really knows what the hell he’s talking about,”

Kelvin Sampson on Gilbert Arenas, Hakeem Olajuwon, Sep 22, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Caron Butler on Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
“It never felt quite right, but now having Gilbert back where he belongs, it’s only right. It feels special.”

Caron Butler on Gilbert Arenas, Nov 19, 2022. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Gilbert Arenas, Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
While talking to Eurohoops after qualifying for the Eurobasket quarterfinals, Dragic didn’t hold any punches on the issue:

“Giannis is the MVP. Gilbert Arenas is not. Was he ever the MVP?I don’t think so. So he can’t talk about Giannis. Giannis won the championship, won the MVP award. He has been the defensive player of the year”

Goran Dragic on Gilbert Arenas, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Sep 10, 2022. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Spencer Dinwiddie on Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Spencer Dinwiddie on being the next Wizards starting PG:

“I'm not Gilbert, John or Russ... I think I'll possibly be the first point guard in D.C. to lobby Senators about Bitcoin.”

Spencer Dinwiddie on Gilbert Arenas, Aug 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Earl Watson on Kobe Bryant, Kevin Durant, Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
“'Stepback, cross, get back to the midpoint, which is on the baseline and find a spot, stepback, fade.'And he was doing them so effortlessly, I was like OK, now I can start reflecting on my time around seeing (Arenas) in the summer. Reflecting on videos of Kobe (Bryant). Now we can start breaking down film of players who I played with who can play outside of a pattern like KD (Kevin Durant).”

Earl Watson on Kobe Bryant, Kevin Durant, Gilbert Arenas, Oct 14, 2020. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Antonio Daniels on Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
“Our lives are full of choices …with Gilbert, you hear so many things about him. He was this and that and gun charges and all these things. I’ll tell you what: my locker was next to Gilbert’s for four years. Gilbert was a great guy. A fantastic guy.”

Antonio Daniels on Gilbert Arenas, Oct 31, 2016. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Caron Butler on Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
And yes, that meant it dealt with the Arenas stuff.

“Gilbert lashed out at me because he thought I was focusing on him,”

Caron Butler on Gilbert Arenas, Sep 1, 2016. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Caron Butler on Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
“We all went to a grand jury and statements were taken so it was something that was already documented. When you’re writing a book, you know that the process is a long interview. “I don’t have any malice in my heart and believe it or not, I love Gilbert. I [loved] Javaris. Those are dudes I went to war with. I would never share information in the locker room or anything that would hurt anyone. But because it was documented, the story was brought up. I gave my take.”

Caron Butler on Gilbert Arenas, Oct 11, 2015. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Caron Butler on Gilbert Arenas, Antawn Jamison
item.description:
Caron Butler:

“It was just kind of something we knew. It was like, ‘Go talk to him.’ [Or] ‘I didn’t talk to him, you talk to him.’ It was just one of those things. But I will say this: whenever you talked to a guy like Gilbert, he always listened. He respected our voices, Antawn and myself. He always listened. And the other guys always listened to us, as well. And just on that particular incident that day, it went too far.”

Caron Butler on Gilbert Arenas, Antawn Jamison, Oct 8, 2015. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Antawn Jamison on Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
Jamison on Arenas:

“He’s a headache but he’s still a good friend and to see the things that he did by being his teammate it’s tough to put anybody above that.”

Antawn Jamison on Gilbert Arenas, Feb 8, 2015. Source: Twitter @jorgeccastillo.

item.title: Yao Ming on Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
“Gilbert is a very nice person. You know they have a word for people, they say, ‘workaholic.’ He’s probably like a ‘playholic.’ He loves to play basketball,”

Yao Ming on Gilbert Arenas, Jan 28, 2013. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Shanghai Sharks on Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
He said,

“One million for Arenas? Who said that? There's still no final confirmation at the present moment. Arenas has already been to two training trials. If we do sign him, it will be for one season.”

Shanghai Sharks on Gilbert Arenas, Nov 9, 2012. Source: Eastday.com.

item.title: Dwight Howard on Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
Dwight Howard:

“The organization did what they felt was best for the team. Bringing Gilbert in is somebody who can create his own shot, but also create for others and score. Bringing a guy like him in was big for us. Why bring (his drama) here? It’s a fresh start for him. He’s looking to get going. We welcome him with open arms. We don’t have no ill will toward him or whatever happened when he was in Washington.”

Dwight Howard on Gilbert Arenas, Jan 13, 2011. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Ernie Grunfeld on Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
From the time of Arenas' suspension last season for bringing guns into the Wizards locker room it was clear, despite what the team said publicly, it was clear the Wizards dreamed of the day might be able to get out of what turned out to be a massive mistake.

“At the time we signed Gilbert, he was one of the top 10 players in the game,”

Ernie Grunfeld on Gilbert Arenas, Dec 19, 2010. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Otis Smith on Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
“With the length of his contract, you're always concerned about taking on more, of course. That's always been one of my concerns. I know a little bit more detail about Gilbert off the court and who he is as a person. He's probably similar to the guys we have in the locker room right now. I would say that sometimes good people make dumb decisions, and he's one of those guys.”

Otis Smith on Gilbert Arenas, Dec 18, 2010. Source: Orlando Sentinel.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
“Gilbert's dealt with a lot of things on the basketball court, but off the court as well. You always like to see a guy who comes through adversity, especially when it looked like earlier in the year, he wasn't there mentally with the team,”

Dwyane Wade on Gilbert Arenas, Nov 30, 2010. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Flip Saunders on Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
Flip Saunders on the comments Gilbert Arenas made about faking an injury:

“One, that’s not totally true. I talked to Gilbert at shootaround, he said his knee was sore, and I told him at that point that he was not going to play. Whatever comments beyond that that Gilbert made, those are untrue comments. He might think that and I know he’s very close to Nick and that, but as I told him and the rest of our team, those guys don’t determine even if Gilbert doesn’t play, who does play. That’s what I do as far as determine. We’ve dealt with it internally, Gilbert is going to be fined for it, and we move on.”

Flip Saunders on Gilbert Arenas, Oct 15, 2010. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.

item.title: Flip Saunders on Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
“All I can do is this, as I said to the team today... I don't question players as far as how they are from their health situation.... Forsomebody sitting out there, do they maybe get frustrated [by Arenas]? I'm sure people get frustrated hearing that. But from my standpoint, as I told our team, I trust all 14, 15 guys that are in that locker room. And so if someone says they're hurt, we move on and put someone else in there. As a player, as a professional athlete, you've got to put yourself in a position to understand that when you step away, whether it's an injury or whatever it is, you put yourself in a situation that someone else can take your spot. And so like I said, so we move on.”

Flip Saunders on Gilbert Arenas, Oct 13, 2010. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Flip Saunders on Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
“Believe it or not, Gilbert has been - in my two years here - the easiest guy that I've had to coach,”

Flip Saunders on Gilbert Arenas, Oct 13, 2010. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Flip Saunders on Gilbert Arenas
item.description:
Saunders told Kevin Sheehan and Thom Loverro.

“So that was more a surprise to me than anybody. My reaction was that was not what was told to me, that's why it was a situation that was handled very quickly, not only in front of Gilbert but in front of the whole team. Actions were taken, and then what you do at that point, we have to move on.”

Flip Saunders on Gilbert Arenas, Oct 13, 2010. Source: Washington Post.
